leftEvidence.title: Glory appears in human likeness and fire

points.label: Divine action
points.left: Above the living beings and platform, Ezekiel sees a throne, a human-like figure, fire, brightness, and rainbow likeness called the LORD’s glory.
points.right: The Lord GOD says restoration is not for Israel’s sake, sanctifies the profaned name, gathers, cleanses, gives a new heart and Spirit, and produces obedience.

points.label: Human response
points.left: Ezekiel falls on his face and hears a voice.
points.right: Israel is restored and then remembers its ways with shame.

payload.posture: Ezekiel’s vision uses layers of likeness; the restoration oracle explains action through the profaned and sanctified name.

rightEvidence.title: God acts for the holy name and renews Israel

payload.tension: God is disclosed through both a guarded vision and public action among nations.
payload.title: Guarded glory and the sanctified name
